title: Model Hub usage summary
description: Metered token usage over a trailing local-day window, aggregated from the turns the gateway proxied. A report only: no consumer of this document may feed it back into resolution, admission, or cooldown.

window_days.description: Requested window after clamping to the retained range.

from_day.description: First local day of the window, present even when it carries no turn.

to_day.description: Last local day of the window, which is the host's today.

sources.description: One entry per Source with at least one metered turn in the window, busiest first.

days.description: One entry per local day carrying a metered turn, oldest first.

Count.description: One metered count: the exact sum of the per-call reports inside the window, each already bounded where it entered the wire. Never clamped to keep it small — a truncated total is indistinguishable from a real one, and clamping a subset and its superset together forces a ratio such as a cached-input share to exactly 100%. The maximum is derived from the producer rather than imposed on the user, and caps nobody's spending: a count is a sum over at most 400 rows (USAGE_MAX_ROWS), each carrying counters of at most 2^53 - 1 (USAGE_COUNTER_CEILING). Both limits are applied when the store is read as well as when it is written, so the bound holds for a corrupt or hand-edited store too and not only for one this producer wrote. A consumer reading this document into IEEE-754 doubles holds every value up to 2^53 - 1 exactly and every larger one as a finite double, rounded in its last places; a window spans at most 62 days of real calls, so only a corrupt or hand-edited store can publish a count in that rounding range.

requests.description: Self-measured upstream calls that reached the model. One turn contributes more than one when it failed over. Always available.

token_reports.description: Metered calls whose upstream response carried a token report. Never greater than requests; a shortfall means missing reports, not zero usage.

input_tokens.description: Vendor-reported input tokens composed per protocol, including tokens served from cache.

cached_input_tokens.description: Subset of input_tokens served from cache.

label.description: Joined from current Source config; null once the Source is gone.

last_metered_at.description: When this Source last had a call metered, served or billed-and-failed.

model_id.description: Ledger key, which for a long identifier is a head plus a digest rather than the identifier itself. Display label, never model_id.

label.description: The model identity this row was metered under, joined from current Source config; null once the model is gone.
